behavior_changes: Cancelled native RPC calls retain the actual SDK observation via turn/start toolOutput in the same thread.
If native already ended, a new native turn is required; otherwise the active turn consumes the observation.
No SDK operation is executed twice; unsuccessful SDK results retain is_error and exact content in the tool-output envelope.
Earlier native final messages are withheld from the SDK during result recovery.
Recovery model work is counted in existing token and native-turn ledgers; tool_result_recoveries.jsonl records call attribution.
limitations: Real CLI protocol and local provider were tested; no real-model semantic behavior is claimed.
The first multiple-call fixture assumed both calls would arrive in one initial HTTP response; it failed that fixture assumption. Its result is retained in candidate_native_multiple.
Recovered native turns are an explicit compatibility behavior, not strict equivalence to the original stateless model API.

The second multiple-call fixture waited for two callbacks inside one exec; this CLI serialized those callbacks. Its failed fixture result is retained in candidate_native_multiple_batched. The passing multiple-cell fixture models two separately yielded exec cells and records callback coalescing explicitly.
